T0536.title: SBOM
T0536.definition: A software bill of materials that lists the components, dependencies, and versions included in software.
T0536.description: An SBOM lists software components and dependencies so teams can quickly identify affected systems when vulnerabilities, malicious packages, or license risks emerge. Effective SBOM use depends on generation timing, dependency depth, version accuracy, and links to artifacts, vulnerability management, asset inventory, and supplier governance.
T0536.usageExample: Assess SBOM related exposure and define the corresponding controls.
